title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
title_zh: 当“必须”变成“也许”：LLM Agent 工作流中的约束弱化
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate complex tasks through multi-role and multi-stage workflows. Upstream state is repeatedly transformed into intermediate language artifacts, such as summaries, plans, tickets, memories, and handoff notes, from which downstream components act. For action-constraining state, topical retention is insufficient: an artifact may mention an unresolved condition while changing it from a requirement that must be resolved before execution into information that may merely inform the next action. We study this action-binding role as operational state preservation. Safety blockers provide a controlled instance because each source state has an explicit prerequisite, authority, fallback, and execution consequence. We condition on correct upstream identification, vary the handoff transformation, and evaluate an executor restricted to the resulting artifact. Across 1,296 controlled synthetic episodes, direct-handoff controls preserve every blocker, whereas compression, plan assimilation, convergence, ownership deferral, and precedent substitution repeatedly turn binding state into caveats or non-binding considerations. Normal handoff compression produces 100.0% deactivation and 54.2% forbidden action. Restoring all four state fields raises preservation to 100.0% and reduces forbidden action to 0.0%. Fixed-artifact interventions further separate preservation from containment: downstream verification eliminates forbidden action while artifact deactivation remains 95.3%. These results identify a state-transmission failure between information extraction and action. Handoff transformations can retain state content while weakening its constraints on downstream action. Semantic availability does not guarantee operational preservation.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent 通过多角色、多阶段工作流协同完成复杂任务。在此过程中，上游状态会被反复转换为摘要、计划、工单、记忆和交接说明等中间语言产物，下游组件再据此行动。对于约束行动的状态，仅保留相关主题并不足够：中间产物可能仍提及某个未解决条件，却将其从“执行前必须满足的要求”弱化为“仅供后续行动参考的信息”。本文将这种对行动约束力的保留称为操作状态保存（operational state preservation）。作者以安全阻断项（safety blockers）作为可控研究对象，因为每个源状态都具有明确的前置条件、决策权限、回退方案和执行后果。实验在确保上游识别正确的前提下，改变交接转换方式，并评估只能访问转换后产物的执行器。在 1,296 个受控合成任务中，直接交接能够保留所有阻断项；而压缩、计划同化、收敛处理、责任延后和先例替代等转换，会反复将具有约束力的状态降级为警示或非强制性考虑。常规交接压缩导致 100.0% 的约束失活和 54.2% 的禁用行动执行率；恢复前置条件、权限、回退方案和执行后果四类状态字段后，保存率提升至 100.0%，禁用行动降至 0.0%。固定中间产物的干预实验进一步区分了状态保存与风险遏制：下游验证虽可消除禁用行动，但中间产物中的约束失活率仍高达 95.3%。结果表明，LLM Agent 工作流存在一种介于信息提取与行动执行之间的状态传递故障：交接转换可以保留状态的语义内容，却削弱其对下游行动的约束力。语义上可获取，并不等同于操作上得到保存。
key_points_zh: 提出操作状态保存（operational state preservation）概念，关注约束是否继续对下游行动具有强制效力，而非仅检查相关信息是否被提及。
在 1,296 个合成任务中，直接交接完整保留安全阻断项，但压缩、计划同化、责任延后等常见转换会系统性削弱约束。
常规交接压缩造成 100.0% 的约束失活，并使执行器在 54.2% 的任务中采取原本被禁止的行动。
完整恢复前置条件、权限、回退方案和执行后果四类字段，可实现 100.0% 的约束保存，并将禁用行动率降至 0.0%。
下游验证可遏制错误行动，却无法修复中间产物中的约束弱化，说明语义保留、操作状态保存与风险遏制是不同问题。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper identifies operational constraint preservation as a distinct workflow-state failure mode and supports it with clear causal interventions.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文将操作约束保持识别为一种独特的工作流状态失效模式，并通过清晰的因果干预加以验证。
